cohort: The study analyzed 150 singleton pregnancies diagnosed with FGR between 28 and 40 weeks of gestation.
finding: The study found high rates of hypertensive disorders and cesarean sections in mothers with FGR, leading to predominately low/very low birth weights, high NICU admissions for various morbidities, a 9.3% neonatal mortality rate, and worse outcomes associated with severe FGR and earlier gestational age at delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were notably high, reflecting the need for timely delivery in FGR cases.
birth_weight: low and very low birth weights
